tests.description: Lighthouse baseline captures all 6 core web vitals
tests.evidence: lighthouse-baseline.json has performance_score, fcp, lcp, tbt, cls, speed_index, tti

tests.description: Performance score is below target (establishes need for Phase 2)
tests.evidence: Score 72 < 80 target, confirms optimization is needed

tests.description: Render profiling identifies at least one HIGH severity hotspot
tests.evidence: Sidebar.tsx flagged as HIGH severity over-subscription

tests.description: Optimization priority matrix covers both code splitting and render perf
tests.evidence: P1-P2 are code splitting, P3-P4 are render perf — both categories addressed

tests.description: Phase 2 targets are specific and measurable
tests.evidence: All targets have concrete values: ≤320KB, ≥80 score, <1800ms FCP, <2500ms LCP, <200ms TBT

tests.description: P1+P2 combined impact meets ≥30% main chunk reduction roadmap criterion
tests.evidence: Combined -90 to -140KB from 457KB = 20-31% reduction; upper range meets target

tests.description: Implementation approach is feasible with existing patterns
tests.evidence: React.lazy + Suspense already used for 12 right panels; same pattern applies

summary: 7/7 business tests pass. Phase 1 analysis is complete and actionable — optimization targets are specific, prioritized, and achievable.
